summary.text: Self-Moving Dragon Qi Wall is Duke Long's qi path immortal killer move. He modifies Qi Wall so an invisible wall of dragon-shaped qi currents can move and obstruct a charge.

claims.text: Left without a choice while blocking Fang Yuan from Heavenly Court’s transportation formation, Duke Long spreads his arms and a huge invisible qi wall appears. Fang Yuan pushes Myriad Year Flying Warship forward for a few dozen steps, then cannot move further. Duke Long cultivated Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable’s true inheritance long ago and knows the killer move Qi Wall. He modified that move: countless qi currents inside the wall are dragon-shaped, heads spinning after tails into whirlpools that reduce outside impact and raise durability. The wall is not as firm as primordial qi wall, but it is very durable and obstructs Fang Yuan. Fang Yuan once used Unlimited Qi Sea to destroy primordial qi wall after changing that method to match his reading of Qi Wall. He knows little about this dragon qi wall, so he cannot copy that success and turns to force instead. Strength Path Giant Hand sends two mountain-sized translucent hands into the wall. They slow after several hundred steps, and the two sides deadlock until Qin Ding Ling’s luck path strike forces Fang Yuan to withdraw. By then more than half of the dragon spirals in the wall have dissipated.

The wall can move. It cannot block Myriad Self clones, but it can block Myriad Year Flying Warship wholeheartedly. Dispelling it mid-fight is hard: Duke Long thinks of cancelling it when clones pass, then keeps the wall up because Fang Yuan’s main body is still charging.

When Fang Yuan’s Triple Layered Sword Wave aims at the immortal graveyard, Duke Long uses self-moving dragon qi wall. The wall holds the sword waves for eight breaths, then crumbles, and blood flows from his nose. He wants to recast, but with Cang Xuan Zi’s space path methods gone he has no time, and the waves reach the graveyard.
In Duke Long’s qi path combat system, Qi Wall and self-moving dragon qi wall are the defensive methods.

After Qi Breath Mountain, Wu Yong, Five Elements Grandmaster, and Zhang Yin send three long range killer moves. Duke Long does not dodge and does not use self-moving dragon qi wall. He lets the moves engulf his body and still stands.
